Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From abbd00b82a2771b0460ba2cffdb1343aa827ccde Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wolfgang Grandegger <wg@grandegger.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Nov 2011 14:30:05 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] net/can/mscan: Fix buggy listen only mode setting

This patch fixes an issue introduced recently with commit
452448f9283e1939408b397e87974a418825b0a8.

CC: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>
Signed-off-by: Wolfgang Grandegger <wg@grandegger.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c b/drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c
index 74f3b1829e02..1c82dd8b896e 100644
--- a/drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c
+++ b/drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c
@@ -581,7 +581,7 @@ static int mscan_open(struct net_device *dev)
 
 	priv->open_time = jiffies;
 
-	if (ctrlmode.flags & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
+	if (priv->can.ctrlmode & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
 		setbits8(&regs->canctl1, MSCAN_LISTEN);
 	else
 		clrbits8(&regs->canctl1, MSCAN_LISTEN);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c`**
- The condition for setting the listen-only mode has been changed. 
- The original line:
  ```c
  if (ctrlmode.flags & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
  ```
  has been modified to:
  ```c
  if (priv->can.ctrlmode & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
  ```
- This change ensures that the listen-only mode is determined based on the `ctrlmode` field of the `priv->can` structure instead of the `ctrlmode.flags`.

### Relationships Between Modifications
- The modification in `mscan.c` directly addresses a bug related to the listen-only mode setting that was introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `452448f9283e1939408b397e87974a418825b0a8`). 
- By changing the condition to use `priv->can.ctrlmode`, the patch corrects the logic for enabling or disabling the listen-only mode, ensuring that the correct state is applied based on the device's current configuration.

Based on your summary and the commit message in the patch, you need to:

1. analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 
2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug. 



Provide a response strictly in the following format:

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (ctrlmode.flags & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
```
Reason:
The incorrect variable `ctrlmode.flags` was used to check for the listen-only mode instead of the appropriate `priv->can.ctrlmode`. This mistake caused the listen-only mode to not be set correctly, potentially allowing the device to operate in a mode that it should not have been in.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (priv->can.ctrlmode & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
```
Reason:
By changing the check to use `priv->can.ctrlmode`, the code now correctly verifies the listen-only mode setting, ensuring that the device operates in the intended mode and preventing it from functioning incorrectly.
